newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Hoare Govett "neutral" on water.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hoare Govett "neutral" on water.

text.p: Analysts at ABN Amro Hoare Govett have reverted to a "neutral" stance on the water sector in 1997 after becoming more positive in the last quarter of 1996.
"We expect much better buying opportunities between the end of March and the election," said Andrew Ord in his latest research. "Sustained outperformance is unlikely until after the election."

Severn Trent remains the key buy in the sector on the hope for further share buybacks. The shares were up 2-1/2p at 682p by 1235 GMT. United Utilities and South West Water are overvalued and remain key sells in the sector.
Shares in United Utilities were up 15p at 640p and South West Water was unchanged at 598p.
Yorkshire Water was downgraded from "buy" to "undervalued", along with Anglian Water. The shares were up 6p at 712-1/2p and 1-1/2p at 588p respectively.
